رَاكِبَةٌ : see the next preceding paragraph. ―
-b2- Also sing. of رَوَاكِبُ (TA) which signifies (tropical:) Streaks [or layers] of fat, (A, K, TA,) overlying one another, (K, TA,) in the fore part of a
camel's hump: those in the hinder part are called رَوَادِفُ, (A, K, TA,) of which the sing. is رَادِفَةٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
